items.meaning: A warning about a limitation.
items.example: One caveat: the sample was small.

items.meaning: Considering, because of.
items.example: In light of the new data, we revised it.

items.meaning: To feel happy about something coming.
items.example: I look forward to meeting you.

items.meaning: To stop trying.
items.example: Do not give up after one mistake.

items.meaning: To understand after thinking.
items.example: I figured out the problem.

items.meaning: To wait before acting.
items.example: Let us hold off until we hear back.

items.meaning: To meet someone by chance.
items.example: I ran into my old teacher.

items.meaning: To think of an idea.
items.example: She came up with the name.

items.meaning: To reach the same level, or to share news.
items.example: Let us catch up next week.

items.meaning: To refuse an offer.
items.example: He turned down the job.

items.meaning: To mention a subject.
items.example: Do not bring that up tonight.

items.meaning: To continue doing something.
items.example: Carry on, I am listening.

items.meaning: To take care of.
items.example: Can you look after the dog?

items.meaning: To resolve or organise something.
items.example: I will sort it out this afternoon.

items.meaning: To draw attention to a fact.
items.example: She pointed out the error politely.

items.meaning: To stop insisting on your position.
items.example: Neither side would back down.

items.meaning: To explain, or to form a part of.
items.example: Travel accounts for half the budget.

items.meaning: To decide something is not possible.
items.example: We cannot rule that out yet.

items.meaning: To do something difficult you planned.
items.example: She went through with the move.

items.meaning: The final problem that makes you act.
items.example: The cancelled flight was the last straw.

translations.es: la gota que colma el vaso

items.meaning: To understand what is implied but not said.
items.example: Read between the lines of that email.

items.meaning: To accept criticism for what you did.
items.example: He had to face the music on Monday.

items.meaning: Something bad that turns out well.
items.example: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.

translations.es: no hay mal que por bien no venga

items.meaning: To do more than is required.
items.example: She always goes the extra mile for clients.

items.meaning: Over a long period of time.
items.example: It is cheaper in the long run.

items.meaning: To stop working for now.
items.example: It is nine - let us call it a day.

items.meaning: To make brief contact to check progress.
items.example: Let us touch base on Thursday.

items.meaning: A small visible part of a large problem.
items.example: The complaints are the tip of the iceberg.

items.meaning: To learn how to do something.
items.example: You get the hang of it after a week.

items.meaning: To avoid saying something directly.
items.example: Stop beating around the bush.

items.meaning: Very rarely.
items.example: We meet once in a blue moon now.

items.meaning: To spend relaxed time together.
items.example: We hung out at the park.

items.meaning: A relaxed way to say it is fine.
items.example: No worries, take your time.

items.meaning: To eat something quickly.
items.example: Let us grab a bite before the film.

items.meaning: Extremely busy.
items.example: Sorry, I was swamped at work.

items.meaning: To be very expensive.
items.example: That laptop cost a fortune.

items.meaning: A casual admission of a mistake.
items.example: My bad, I sent the wrong file.

items.meaning: An advance warning.
items.example: Thanks for the heads-up.

items.meaning: Willing and keen to do something.
items.example: Are you up for it on Saturday?

items.meaning: Very tired, informally.
items.example: I am absolutely knackered.

items.meaning: Difficult to believe or achieve.
items.example: Finishing by Friday is a stretch.

items.meaning: To do something without preparing.
items.example: I had no slides, so I winged it.

items.meaning: Feeling sure about yourself.
items.example: I feel confident speaking English.

items.meaning: To get better.
items.example: My listening improved a lot.

items.meaning: A small failure to notice something.
items.example: Leaving her name off was an oversight.

items.meaning: To do something regularly to get better.
items.example: I practise for ten minutes daily.

items.meaning: Able to speak easily and smoothly.
items.example: She is fluent in three languages.

items.meaning: The way you sound when you speak.
items.example: Everyone has an accent.

items.meaning: Showing good manners.
items.example: Adding please sounds more polite.

items.meaning: Easy to see or understand.
items.example: The answer was obvious afterwards.

items.meaning: Used to join two contrasting ideas.
items.example: Although it rained, we walked.

items.meaning: Helpful for a purpose.
items.example: That was a useful tip.

items.meaning: Hard to do or understand.
items.example: The exam was difficult but fair.

items.meaning: To choose after thinking.
items.example: We decided to wait a week.

items.meaning: To like one thing more than another.
items.example: I prefer tea to coffee.

items.meaning: Free to be used or seen.
items.example: Are you available on Thursday?

items.meaning: Needed, not optional.
items.example: A visa is necessary for that trip.

items.meaning: Correct in every detail.
items.example: The figures are accurate to the penny.

items.meaning: Unwilling, doing something slowly.
items.example: He was reluctant to agree.

items.meaning: Done on purpose.
items.example: That omission was deliberate.

items.meaning: Seeming reasonable, though maybe untrue.
items.example: It is plausible but unproven.

items.meaning: Certain to happen.
items.example: The delay was inevitable.

items.meaning: Chosen with no clear reason.
items.example: The deadline felt arbitrary.

items.meaning: Having more than one possible meaning.
items.example: The wording is ambiguous.
